svg.title: NET-05-R — Non-final round result
svg.desc: Existing non-final round-result panel above one shared arena at 1280 by 900. Fixed round progress and SCORE heading, bounded ranking, separate outcome and countdown, and existing host actions. The first-second active and final-five-second frozen phases use the same layout. Top-left diagram coordinates.

g.text: Rank / Player or team / Points / Existing state cues
[Diagram annotation: additional ranking rows scroll here]
Existing ranking position when scrolling is needed
Session only scores • Optional scripts disabled
ANNOTATIONS — representative values are illustrative; capture an actual authoritative outcome.
Read progress → score heading → ranking → outcome / phase → existing session actions.
First-second variant: World active • 1s. Later phase: frozen with automatic next-round countdown.
Guest variant retains Leave session without Advance round. Final rounds use NET-06, not this variant.
NET-05 / UX-NET-05-009–016. Long outcomes wrap above phase text and reduce the scrolling ranking height.
